key_insight: Token steering across transformer layers is formulated as minimum-effort mean-field control on the unit sphere, yielding a geometry-aware Schrödinger bridge.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled way to guide aggregate token representations toward a target configuration over a fixed layer-depth horizon.
method: Model attention-coupled stochastic tokens as interacting particles on the unit sphere.
Derive a controlled mean-field integro-PDE and minimum-effort feedback field.
Generalize dynamic Sinkhorn recursion to compute consistent token evolution.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments report exact token-population steering, but the abstract provides no benchmark details or quantitative metrics.
watch_item: Scalability and steering accuracy for finite token populations in practical transformers remain unclear from the abstract.
